name: Sidney Flees on the Highway
description: The highway stretches empty under the cover of night. Sidney appears suddenly, speeding into view in her Honda Civic, tires humming against the asphalt as she drives fast through the darkness.
related_events: Sidney speeds on a desolate highway at night

name: Sarah Darling Arrives at the Compound
description: Sarah Darling drives her Porsche through the main gates of the compound and rounds a corner, continuing along the access road.
related_events: Sarah Darling arrives at the compound by driving through the main gates

name: Sidney Speeds Up in the Dark
description: Sidney taps her thumbs against the steering wheel as an eerie song plays from the radio. The dashboard casts a dim, neon green glow, illuminating her face. She presses down on the accelerator, increasing the car's speed along the dark road.
related_events: Sidney increases vehicle speed while driving nervously

name: Ben Arrives in a Hurry
description: Ben comes screeching around the corner in his Ford Explorer. The tires smoke and sparks fly as the vehicle speeds forward. The Hollywood sign looms in the distance behind him.
related_events: Ben arrives at high speed in his Ford Explorer

name: Locking the Offices
description: A security guard opens the front door and calls out, 'Mr. Bridger?' When there is no answer, he nods, steps back, and locks the office doors behind him, leaving Sarah and the killer inside.
related_events: Security guard locks offices with Sarah and the killer inside

name: Sarah Arrives at the Offices as the Killer Watches from Above
description: Sarah pulls up outside the production offices, steps out of her car, and starts walking toward the dimly lit building. Above, on the rooftop, the killer remains hidden, watching her every move.
related_events: Sarah exits her car outside the production offices
Killer observes Sarah from rooftop

name: Sarah Sees a Shape and Flees to the Prop Room
description: Sarah stands still, staring at the front door. Through the smoked glass, she sees a shape moving toward her. She screams, turns abruptly, and sprints across the room, heading for the prop room. The door swings shut behind her as she disappears inside.
related_events: Sarah sees a shape approaching through the front door
Sarah screams and runs to the prop room

name: Dewey Arrives at the Stab 3 Set
description: A red BMW convertible speeds through the back lot of a film studio, weaving past production trailers and set pieces. Dewey Rielly steers the car toward a soundstage, pulls up beside a row of parked crew vehicles, and brings the convertible to a stop. He steps out, closes the door behind him, and stands beside the car as banners for STAB 3: RETURN TO WOODSBORO flutter in the breeze overhead.
related_events: Dewey Rielly drives red BMW convertible through back lot
Dewey Rielly exits vehicle at soundstage

name: Sidney Heads to the Bathroom Alone
description: Sidney stands beside Dewey and Detective Wallace and says she needs to go to the bathroom. Dewey asks if she wants him to come with her, reminding her of Randy's warning. Sidney declines, smiling as she holds up her mace and knife, then raises her fists playfully. Detective Wallace offers a police escort, but she assures them both that she will be fine. She turns and walks toward the soundstage, leaving them behind.
related_events: Sidney announces need to use bathroom during gathering with Dewey and Detective Wallace
Sidney declines police escort to bathroom despite safety concerns
Sidney walks toward soundstage after conversation about bathroom break

name: Sid Washes Up and Sees Her Scars
description: Sid stands at the sink, washing her hands. She wipes tears from her eyes with the back of her wrist. The water stops running as she turns off the tap. She looks up, meeting her reflection in the mirror. The camera moves in close on her wrists, where two scars run lengthwise, pale against her skin.
related_events: Sid washes up at the sink and wipes tears from her eyes
Sid shuts off the running water and looks into the mirror
Close-up reveals scars on Sid's wrists

name: Sarah Hides from the Ghost Costumes
description: Sarah locks the apartment door and steps back, startled by the sight of at least thirty ghost costumes hanging from racks. She quickly dives into one of the racks, pulling herself among the hanging figures, and pulls out her cell phone as she crouches in hiding.
related_events: Sarah locks the apartment door and encounters ghost costumes
Sarah hides among the costume racks

name: Sarah Hides and Makes a Phone Call
description: Sarah crouches behind a rack of ghost costumes, her breath quickening. She pulls out her cell phone and begins dialing a number.
related_events: Sarah attempts to call someone using her cell phone

name: Sidney's Nightmare and Awakening
description: Sidney Prescott lies in bed, her black lab Pete curled at her feet. A sudden noise wakes the dog, barking frantically at the bedroom window. Sidney stirs, opening her eyes and squinting toward the glass. She sees the ghostly figure of her mother, Maureen, pressed against the outside of the window, wearing a tattered, blood-soaked night shift. Her lips move silently, as if trying to speak. Sidney's breath catches. The dog continues to bark. Then, Maureen's figure slides downward, disappearing below the sill. Five bloody streaks appear on the glass, oozing as if freshly cut, bleeding through the pane from the outside. Sidney reaches toward them. Suddenly, a ghostly figure surges up behind the window and smashes through the glass with a fist. Sidney screams—then jolts upright in bed, gasping. The room is dark. The window is intact. Pete barks wildly beside her. Sidney swings her legs off the bed, crawls to her feet, and walks out of the room.
related_events: Sidney Prescott is startled awake by her dog barking at the bedroom window
Sidney sees the ghostly apparition of her mother at the window
Maureen Prescott's ghost slides down the window out of sight
Five bloody streaks appear and bleed through the bedroom window glass
Ghost of Maureen Prescott shatters the bedroom window with his fist
Sidney Prescott awakens in bed from a nightmare
Sidney Prescott crawls out of bed and leaves the bedroom

name: Arrival at the STAB Lot
description: Kincaid and Dewey drive through the STAB Production lot and park near a row of trailers. Dewey steps out of the truck with Gale and Sidney. He points toward a building and tells Sidney it's the production office where Sarah Darling was murdered the night before.
related_events: Kincaid and Dewey arrive at the STAB Production lot
Dewey informs Sidney about Sarah Darling's murder

name: Karen Arrives with Randy's Final Message
description: Karen Colcheck, a young woman from Woodsboro, suddenly appears and startles Sidney, Dewey, and Gale. She holds a videotape labeled SCARY MOVIES 101, which she found while going through Randy Meeks' belongings. The group gathers around as the tape is played. On the screen, Randy Meeks appears, his image flickering to life with a knowing smile. 'Told you I'd make a movie someday, huh?' he says, his voice echoing in the quiet room.
related_events: Karen Colcheck startles Sidney, Dewey, and Gale
Karen presents a video tape from Randy Meeks' belongings
Randy Meeks' recorded message plays on the video monitor

name: Jennifer, Gale, and Dewey Escape the Explosion as the Ghost Flees
description: The house erupts in a massive explosion, shattering windows and splintering the roof. Flames surge into the night as Jennifer, Gale, and Dewey leap through the patio doors and dive into the swimming pool to avoid the blast. Debris crashes down around them. From the shadows, the Ghost watches the fire consume the house, his pale mask reflecting the flickering light. As sirens wail in the distance, he turns and runs into the darkness, dropping a newspaper clipping onto the ground. The wind catches it, flipping it over to reveal handwritten words on the back: 'I KILLED HER'.
related_events: Explosion destroys house and blows out windows
Jennifer, Gale, and Dewey dive into swimming pool to escape explosion
Ghost watches explosion from shadows and flees
Ghost drops newspaper clipping at explosion site

name: The Clipping in the Wind
description: After the explosion, the Ghost flees into the night, leaving behind a newspaper clipping that flutters to the ground. A pair of hands reaches down, picks it up, and turns it over. On the back, handwriting stands out in jagged letters: 'I KILLED HER'.
related_events: Unknown person picks up newspaper clipping and reveals message

name: Gale Leads Jennifer Down the Dark Hallway
description: Gale walks ahead, guiding Jennifer through a dimly lit hallway. Jennifer hesitates, muttering that basements creep her out. Gale continues forward, unfazed, as they move toward the basement.
related_events: Gale leads Jennifer down a dark hallway
Jennifer expresses discomfort about basements

name: Gale and Jennifer Exchange Sarcastic Remarks
description: Gale leads the way down the dark hall. Jennifer says basements creep her out. Gale smiles and tells her she'd make a fascinating interview, calling it 'Lifestyles of the Rich and Psychotic.' Jennifer shoots back, 'Look who's talking, Moneybags. You got more homes than I do.' Gale laughs and says she wishes she'd recorded that, because it would cheer her up every time she's down. Jennifer mutters 'Bitch' under her breath as the two turn the corner and step into the next room.
related_events: Gale compliments Jennifer with sarcastic flair
Jennifer retorts with a sarcastic comment about Gale's wealth
Gale expresses amusement and wishes she had recorded the exchange

name: Jennifer mutters an insult as they turn the corner
description: Gale leads the way down the dark hall. Jennifer says she hates basements. Gale teases her, saying she'd make a fascinating interview—'Lifestyles of the Rich and Psychotic.' Jennifer shoots back, calling Gale 'Moneybags' and pointing out she owns more homes. Gale smiles, saying she wishes she'd recorded that. As they turn the corner, Jennifer mutters 'Bitch' under her breath. They step into a new space.
related_events: Jennifer mutters an insult under her breath
Gale and Jennifer turn a corner into a new space

name: Sidney and Karen's Final Hug
description: Sidney thanks Karen, telling her to be careful. Karen smiles and reassures him, saying not to worry. She admits she had another reason for coming—to get tickets to see Family Feud. They share one last hug before Karen hurries away.
related_events: Sidney thanks Karen and they share a farewell hug
Karen reveals her ulterior motive for visiting

name: Gale Leaves to Investigate Alone
description: Gale tells the others he has an idea and will meet up with them later. Dewey asks if he should come along, but Gale says he works better alone. Without further explanation, he runs off. Sidney and Dewey watch him go.
related_events: Gale decides to split from the group
Dewey offers to accompany Gale
Gale runs off to pursue his own plan

name: Sidney and Dewey on the Set
description: After Gale runs off, Sidney and Dewey are left alone. Sidney says nothing has changed. They stay behind as Dewey suggests they do some snooping around the set.
related_events: Sidney observes that nothing has changed

name: Tom Searches for Angelina in the Dark
description: Tom steps out into the darkness, scanning the area as he calls out for Angelina. 'Angelina! Hey! Where the hell are you? I was only playing! Hey look, I can really get you a bit part! Just come on out! Ok?' He pauses, waiting, but there is no response. 'Damn it. There goes my chances of getting some head from her.' He pulls out a joint, puts it in his mouth, and lights it. As he walks around the side of the house, a noise catches his attention—a low, muffled squealing. 'Aaaangelina?' He turns toward a guest house. The door is half open, darkness spilling out. Tom smirks and steps inside.
related_events: Tom calls out for Angelina in the dark
Tom expresses frustration over lost romantic opportunity

name: Tom Smokes a Joint and Investigates the Property
description: After calling out for Angelina and receiving no response, Tom pulls out a joint, lights it, and begins walking around the side of the house. As he moves through the darkness, a muffled squealing sound catches his attention. He turns toward the guest house, where the door stands half open, and steps inside.
related_events: Tom smokes a joint and investigates the property

name: Tom Investigates a Strange Noise and Enters the Guest House
description: Tom hears a low, muffled squealing coming from the guest house. The door is half open, darkness spilling out. He smirks, then steps inside.
related_events: Tom hears muffled squealing from guest house
Tom enters the guest house with smirk

name: Milton Vanishes, Trio Emerges from Closet
description: Milton steps out of his office and walks into the reception area, where he disappears from view. The coat closet door creaks open and Gale, Jennifer, and Dewey emerge from the darkness. Jennifer gags, complaining that Dewey’s nervousness is making her sick. Dewey and Gale both tell her to be quiet. Jennifer insists that Milton is the killer and believes he has left to attack another cast member. Gale dismisses the idea, calling Milton a pervert who likely left for a solitary indulgence. Jennifer misinterprets the joke, naming Rob Reiner and Quentin Tarantino. Gale, exasperated, clarifies she meant his hands. Dewey hushes them both and cautiously approaches Milton’s office, slowly opening the door. The three step inside as darkness fills the room.
related_events: Milton leaves office and disappears into reception area
Gale, Jennifer, and Dewey emerge from coat closet
Jennifer expresses distress and accuses Dewey of causing her to gag

name: Jennifer Suspects Milton, Misunderstands Gale's Joke
description: Milton steps out of his office and disappears down the hall. The coat closet creaks open, and Gale, Jennifer, and Dewey emerge. Jennifer gags, complaining that Dewey’s nervousness is making her sick. She insists Milton is the killer and has gone to murder another cast member. Gale scoffs, calling Milton a pervert who likely left to buy more KY Jelly for his solo activities. Jennifer asks if she means Rob Reiner and Quentin Tarantino. Gale smacks her forehead in frustration. Dewey hushes them both and cautiously opens Milton’s office door. The three slip inside as darkness spills into the hallway.
related_events: Jennifer voices suspicion that Milton is the killer
Gale makes sarcastic remark about Milton's personal life
Jennifer misinterprets Gale's joke as reference to famous directors
Gale expresses frustration at Jennifer's lack of understanding
Gale clarifies the joke by indicating Milton's hands

name: Entering Milton's Office
description: After telling Jennifer to be quiet, Dewey leans toward Milton's office door, slowly opens it, and steps inside. Gale and Jennifer follow as the three disappear into the darkness of the office.
related_events: Gale and Dewey simultaneously tell Jennifer to be quiet
Dewey signals for silence and leads Gale and Jennifer into Milton's office

name: The Ghost Attacks Tom After He Finds Angelina's Body
description: The ghost peels away from the wall, emerging from the darkness. Tom, unaware at first, stops moving when he sees Angelina Tyler lying in a pool of blood at his feet. Before he can react, the ghost grabs him, slashes his arm, and forces him backward toward the kitchen.
related_events: Ghost detaches from wall and confronts Tom
Tom discovers Angelina Tyler's body in pool of blood
Ghost attacks Tom by slashing his arm

name: The Ghost Chokes Tom and Prepares to Deliver the Fatal Blow
description: After slashing Tom's arm, the ghost grabs him by the throat and lifts him into the air. Tom struggles, gagging, unable to scream as the pressure crushes his windpipe and a trickle of blood runs from his lips. The ghost holds him aloft, one hand tightening around his neck, while the other angles the knife, poised to strike. Tom kicks weakly, suspended and helpless, as the ghost readies the killing stab.
related_events: Ghost grabs Tom by the throat and begins choking him mid-air
Ghost angles knife and prepares to deliver kill blow to Tom

name: The Ghost Stabs Tom and Surveys the Body
description: The ghost drives the knife into Tom's heart, pinning him to the closet. Tom kicks and writhes for a moment, then goes still. The ghost releases his grip, steps back, and looks at Tom's lifeless body.
related_events: Ghost stabs Tom through the heart and pins him to the closet
Tom struggles momentarily after being stabbed before dying
Ghost steps back and admires Tom's lifeless body

name: Gale Meets Detective Kincaid and Learns of the Murders
description: Gale rounds a corner on the set and collides with Detective Mark Kincaid, who steadies her and introduces himself, flashing his badge. He asks her about actor Ben Damon and actress Christine Perkins. Gale recalls interviewing Damon, calling him obnoxious, and remembers that Perkins played CICI in Stab 2. Kincaid informs her that both Damon and Perkins were found murdered that morning beneath the Hollywood sign, their bodies resembling scenes from the Stab films. He then produces a newspaper clipping in a ziplock bag showing an article about the murder of Maureen Prescott, Sidney Prescott’s mother. On the back, the name "SIDNEY" is scrawled in black marker. Kincaid says he cannot locate Sidney and asks for Gale’s help. Gale responds that she does not know where Sidney is and that the only other person who might know is someone who won’t talk.
related_events: Gale collides with Detective Mark Kincaid on set
Detective Kincaid identifies himself to Gale
Detective Kincaid questions Gale about Ben Damon and Christine Perkins
Detective Kincaid reveals murders of Ben Damon and Christine Perkins
Gale recalls interviewing Ben Damon and Christine Perkins' role in Stab 2

name: Detective Kincaid Warns Gale About the Threat to Sidney
description: Detective Mark Kincaid pulls a newspaper clipping from his pocket and holds it up for Gale Weathers to see. The article reports the brutal murder of Maureen Prescott, with a black-and-white photo of her on the page. Gale recognizes her as Sidney Prescott's mother. Kincaid flips the clipping over, revealing a message scrawled in black marker: 'SIDNEY'. He tells Gale he has been unable to reach Sidney and that her life may be in danger. He insists that Gale is his only hope in finding her.
related_events: Detective Kincaid shows newspaper clipping to Gale
Detective Kincaid reveals killer's message on newspaper clipping
Detective Kincaid expresses concern for Sidney Prescott's safety

name: Gale Confronted by Detective Over Sidney's Whereabouts
description: Gale rounds a corner and collides with Detective Mark Kincaid, who identifies himself and shows her his badge. She reacts with shock, then irritation at being pulled away from her show. Kincaid asks if she knows Ben Damon or Christine Perkins. Gale recalls interviewing Damon and recognizes Perkins from her role in Stab 2. The detective reveals both were found murdered under the Hollywood sign, their bodies resembling scenes from the Stab films. He produces a newspaper clipping in a plastic evidence bag showing an article about Maureen Prescott’s murder. On the back, the name "SIDNEY" is written in black marker. Kincaid says he cannot reach Sidney and pleads for Gale’s help in finding her. Gale responds that she does not know where Sidney is and that after Windsor, she disappeared. She mentions another person might know but adds that this person will not talk. Kincaid presses her, asking who it could be, but Gale does not answer.
related_events: Gale expresses frustration at being detained for questioning
Gale refuses to disclose Sidney's possible location

name: Gale's Attempted Break-In
description: Gale banged on the door of a restricted building, trying to force her way in. Finding no one home, she noticed the card lock and the sign that read 'AUTHORIZED PERSONAL ONLY'. She smiled, pulled out several cards from her pocketbook—credit cards, a video store card—and tried to slide them into the lock. None worked. Suddenly, a hand grabbed her from behind. She screamed, startled, but it was only Jennifer. After a tense exchange, Jennifer revealed she had a key card from Sunrise Studios, swiped it, and opened the door, stepping inside first. The door closed behind them with a loud clack.
related_events: Gale attempts to break into restricted area using fake credentials

name: Jennifer ambushes Gale and insists on staying with her
description: Gale stands at a locked door, trying to gain entry with a series of cards. The lock doesn't budge. Suddenly, a hand grabs her from behind. She screams, spinning around to find Jennifer. 'Geez,' Jennifer says. Gale demands to know what she's doing. Jennifer replies, 'Being Gale Weathers.' Gale insists she is Gale Weathers. Jennifer explains her reasoning: she has lost her home, her film project, and her sense of safety, and she’s being stalked—not because anyone wants to kill her, but because they want to kill Gale. From now on, she will stay with Gale. That way, if the killer comes, they’ll go after Gale, not her. Gale says it makes no sense. Jennifer responds that in the movies, she portrays Gale as much smarter. Gale retorts that playing a sane person must be a stretch. Jennifer ignores the jab and asks if Gale needs to get into the building. When Gale answers sarcastically, Jennifer pulls out a Sunrise Studios key card. 'Gale Weathers would find a way,' she says, swiping the card and opening the door. She steps inside first. Gale follows. The door closes behind them with a loud clack.
related_events: Jennifer startles Gale from behind causing a scream
Jennifer presents her logic for staying with Gale

name: Gale and Jennifer's Identity Standoff
description: Gale lets out a scream as a hand grabs her from behind, only to see it's Jennifer. Startled, Gale demands what Jennifer is doing. Jennifer replies, 'Being Gale Weathers.' Confused, Gale insists, 'I am Gale Weathers!' Jennifer responds by laying out her reasoning: she has lost her home, her movie, her gun, and is being stalked—not because someone wants to kill her, but because they want to kill Gale. From now on, she says, she will follow Gale everywhere. If someone comes for her, they’ll find Gale instead, and since the killer wants Gale, Jennifer will be safe. Gale says it makes no sense. Jennifer remarks that in the movies, she portrays Gale as much smarter. Gale retorts that playing a sane person must be a stretch for Jennifer. Jennifer flashes a Sunrise Studios key card and says, 'Gale Weathers would find a way.' She swipes the card, opens the door, and steps inside first. Gale follows, the door closing behind them with a loud clack.
related_events: Gale and Jennifer confront each other's identity
Jennifer mocks Gale's intelligence and sanity

name: Jennifer Opens the Door and They Enter Together
description: Jennifer swipes a Sunrise Studios key card through the lock, opens the door, and steps inside first. Gale follows her into the building. The door closes behind them with a loud clack.
related_events: Jennifer uses key card to access restricted building
Gale and Jennifer enter the building and door closes behind them

name: Dewey Calls Sidney
description: Dewey stands on his cell phone, speaking into the receiver as Sidney's answering machine picks up. 'Sid, it's me, this is the sixth time I've called,' he says, his voice tense. 'Please pick up, I wanna make sure you're okay.' As he continues pleading, Sidney appears around the corner, escorted by a police officer. Dewey sees her, calls out her name, and they rush toward each other, embracing tightly.
related_events: Dewey leaves a message on Sidney's answering machine

name: Sidney Arrives and Reunites with Dewey
description: Sidney turns the corner and walks down the hallway, guided by a police officer. Dewey, standing nearby, notices her and calls out. They run toward each other and embrace tightly. Dewey asks why she is there, telling her it's not safe. Sidney replies that the killer found her and called the night before, so she came to be with the people she cares about. She asks about the Kincaid case and mentions seeing the location on a news report. Dewey tells her to follow him and leads her into Kincaid's office.
related_events: Sidney is escorted down the hall by a police officer

name: Dewey and Sidney Reunite in the Hallway
description: Dewey sees Sidney approaching down the hall, calls out to her, and they run toward each other, embracing tightly. Dewey pulls back and asks why she’s there, reminding her he had told her to stay hidden because it wasn’t safe. Sidney replies that she wasn’t safe where she was either—the killer had found her and called the night before. She decided to come to be with the people she cares about. After a brief pause, she asks where the Kincaid guy is, mentioning she found the location from a FOX 5 news report. Dewey tells her to follow him and leads her into Kincaid’s office.
related_events: Dewey and Sidney reunite and embrace
Dewey expresses concern for Sidney's safety

name: Sidney Arrives After Receiving a Threat
description: Sidney approaches Dewey and tells him the killer called her the night before. She says she no longer felt safe hiding alone and decided to come to the location to be with people she cares about. Dewey listens, then leads her toward Kincaid's office.
related_events: Sidney reveals that the killer called her the previous night
Sidney explains her reason for coming to the location

name: Sidney Finds Dewey and Seeks Officer Kincaid
description: Sidney arrives at the station after seeing a FOX 5 news report. She asks Dewey about Officer Kincaid, wanting to know where he is and who he is. Dewey responds by leading her down the hall and into Kincaid's office.
related_events: Sidney inquires about Officer Kincaid based on a news report
Dewey leads Sidney into Kincaid's office

name: Detectives Question Roman About Sarah Darling
description: Detectives Wallace and Kincaid sit across from Roman Bridger at a long conference table inside the studio. They press him about a meeting with Sarah Darling before her death, claiming a guard saw her there to meet him. Roman insists he never spoke to her. The detectives bring up a call to Sarah’s apartment, saying her roommate recognized Roman’s voice. Roman denies making the call, repeating he had no contact with Sarah. He grows agitated, accusing someone of setting him up to sabotage his film. The detectives remain skeptical as the room falls tense.
related_events: Detectives question Roman about his contact with Sarah Darling
Detectives present evidence from Sarah Darling's roommate
Roman denies calling Sarah Darling or meeting with her
related_occasions: Interrogation At The Studio Conference Room

name: Roman Accuses an Unknown Saboteur as Production Is Shut Down
description: Roman sits across from Detectives Wallace and Kincaid at a long conference table, his composure unraveling as they press him about a call to Sarah Darling. He insists he never spoke to her, never arranged a meeting, and did not speak to her roommate. When the detectives mention the roommate recognized his voice, Roman grows more agitated, insisting he was not the caller. He abruptly shifts focus, claiming someone is trying to ruin his film by framing him. Before the detectives can respond, he reveals the studio has shut down production, calling the project too risky in light of the murder. He scoffs at the decision, comparing it to the troubled filming of The Exorcist. Detective Wallace makes a dry comment about the incident being material for a director’s commentary, but Roman barely reacts, consumed by the news of his film’s cancellation. A camera pulls back, passing through a two-way mirror, revealing observers on the other side.
related_events: Roman claims someone is trying to sabotage his movie
Roman reveals the studio is shutting down production of his film
related_occasions: Interrogation At The Studio Conference Room

name: Detective Kincaid Draws Line Between Past Accidents and Current Murder
description: Roman brings up the deaths that occurred during the filming of The Exorcist, arguing that fatalities on set are not unheard of. Detective Kincaid responds by pointing out key differences: Sarah Darling was stabbed, and the killer left messages for the police at the scene. He makes clear that this was not an accident or a tragic coincidence, but a deliberate act that sets it apart from any past incidents on film sets.
related_events: Detective Kincaid compares the current murder to fatalities during The Exorcist filming
related_occasions: Interrogation At The Studio Conference Room

name: Bianca Meets Gale and Jennifer
description: Bianca Bernadette, seated behind a desk and occupied with paperwork, pauses and looks up upon sensing someone nearby. She sees Gale and Jennifer standing before her. 'Can I help you?' she asks. Gale steps forward and introduces herself as Gale Weathers, author of books about the Woodsboro and Windsor College murders, and an anchorwoman for TOTAL ENTERTAINMENT. She asks if Bianca has heard of her. Bianca shakes her head. Gale then asks if the name Maureen Prescott means anything to her. Bianca replies, 'Nope.'
related_events: Bianca Bernadette stops working and looks up at Gale and Jennifer
Gale Weathers introduces herself and her credentials
Bianca Bernadette denies recognizing Gale or Maureen Prescott

name: Gale Presents a Photograph to Bianca
description: Gale Weathers shows a photograph of Sid's mother to Bianca Bernadette, placing it on the desk in front of her. Bianca glances at the photo without interest and states she is busy, reiterating that only studio executives have access to the files. She tells Gale and Jennifer to leave.
related_events: Gale Weathers presents a photograph of Sid's mother
Bianca Bernadette refuses access to studio files and demands departure

name: Bribery Escalates with a Valuable Ring
description: Gale Weathers places a twenty-dollar bill on Bianca Bernadette's desk, attempting to persuade her to provide access to restricted files. Bianca looks at the money, unimpressed, and slides it back, remarking on the studio president with sarcasm. Jennifer then steps forward, removes a ring from her finger, and slams it onto the desk, declaring it worth at least three thousand dollars. Bianca studies the ring, smiles, and puts it on. She tells them to follow her.
related_events: Gale Weathers places a twenty dollar bill on the desk to bribe Bianca Bernadette
Bianca Bernadette rejects the twenty dollar bill and references the studio president
Jennifer offers her expensive ring as a bribe to Bianca Bernadette

name: Bianca Takes Control
description: Bianca Bernadette picked up Jennifer's ring from the desk, slipped it onto her finger, and nodded. As Gale reached for her twenty-dollar bill, Bianca slapped her hand away, took the bill, folded it, and tucked it between her cleavage. Without a word, she stood and motioned for them to follow.
related_events: Bianca Bernadette accepts Jennifer's ring and agrees to assist
Bianca Bernadette slaps Gale Weathers' hand and takes the twenty dollar bill for herself

name: Sarah breaks and tries to fix Roman's award
description: Sarah sits alone in Roman's office, looking around at the old movie memorabilia. She picks up one of his brass music video awards and reads the inscription. The phone rings suddenly, startling her. She drops the award, and it hits the edge of the desk, snapping the head off. She hesitates, then answers the call, putting it on speakerphone. After speaking with Roman, she grabs the broken award and tries to fix it with scotch tape.
related_events: Sarah drops and breaks Roman's music video award
Sarah attempts to repair the broken award with scotch tape

name: Roman Calls Sarah from the 405 to Discuss Her Character
description: Roman calls Sarah from his car while stuck in traffic on the 405 freeway. He apologizes for being late and says he’s only minutes away. Over the speakerphone, he shifts the conversation to her character in the film. Sarah responds with growing frustration, telling him she’s unhappy playing a 21-year-old at 35, upset about dying naked, and annoyed that her character doesn’t own a gun despite her boyfriend having been murdered. Roman listens and then suggests they run lines from page 22 of the script.
related_events: Roman calls Sarah from traffic on the 405 freeway
Sarah expresses dissatisfaction with her film role

name: Sarah and Roman Rehearse Amid Script Chaos
description: Sarah sits at Roman's desk, holding a broken music video award she accidentally dropped. The phone rings, and she answers, putting it on speaker. Roman tells her he’s running late and begins directing her through a scene. They start reading lines from page 22, but Sarah stops, frustrated. She questions why her character, Candy, begins the scene in the shower, arguing it makes no sense given her boyfriend’s recent death. Roman insists on continuing, asking about the name Candy, but then veers off-script, saying his favorite name is Sarah. She protests—it’s not the line. Roman says it’s in his script now. Sarah yells about constant rewrites and asks if there’s been another change. Roman replies that it’s not just a rewrite—it’s a new movie. A pause.
